subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

Apple growers in Himachal Pradesh says they are harvesting a bumper crop this year due to good weather conditions.

options.text: Apple growers in Himachal Pradesh says

solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **Apple growers in Himachal Pradesh says**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace '**says**' with '**say**' to make the sentence correct.
 
• The error in the sentence lies in **subject-verb agreement.**
 
• The basic rule states that a singular subject takes a singular verb while a plural subject takes a plural verb. 
 
• **Says **is third person singular verb.
 
• "**Apple growers**" is a plural subject so we cannot use '**says**'.
 
• '**They**' is also a plural pronoun used in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**, which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence:** *Apple growers in Himachal Pradesh **say __**they are harvesting a bumper crop this year due to good weather conditions. *
